task_definition.task_description: Check the current time in New York, then look up Alice's contact card. After that, get a quote for AAPL and check the Yahoo market window status. Please archive that market window information as a high-priority email for Alice with the title "2026-02-22", and finally, place an equity order for AAPL for the amount of 10000.5.

user_input.query: Could you please check the current time in America/New_York and then look up the contact card for alice? I also need you to get a stock quote for AAPL and check the status of the Yahoo market window. Once you have that, please archive the market window information by sending a high priority email to alice with the title "2026-02-22". Finally, I would like to place an equity order for AAPL for the amount of 10000.5.
